title: ONSure Session Lifecycle Disposition v1
description: NFR-SESSION (03 Security Review, DRAFT C12): '만료된 세션으로의 요청은 거부되어야 하고, 동일 사용자의 동시 활성 세션 수가 상한을 넘으면 가장 오래된 세션이 무효화되어야 한다.' Records the outcome of creating one session: the new session's own fields (always status=ACTIVE, since a record describing a rejected/expired attempt is a different concern) plus evicted_session_id, an independent nullable field naming a DIFFERENT, pre-existing session evicted as a side effect when active_session_count_before_create had already reached session_ceiling. The count>=ceiling implies-eviction invariant is a cross-field numeric comparison JSON Schema without $data cannot express declaratively -- enforced by the Java runtime layer (SessionLedger.create), documented honestly here rather than faked with an unrelated proxy constraint, same pattern as main-branch-protection.v1.json and decision-time-knowledge-snapshot.v1.schema.json.
$comment: No further allOf: 'evicted_session_id must differ from session_id' and the count>=ceiling implies-eviction invariant are both cross-field comparisons JSON Schema without $data cannot express declaratively. Both are enforced by SessionLedger.create() and covered by SessionLedgerTest, not faked here as a schema constraint.
